rationale: Codex's implementation is the most complete: its guidance generation covers owner retry, whole-cohort resets and amendment suspend/restore plus an in-flight upgrade guard, and its terminal layer has cancellable polling, confirmed drops, bracketed-paste safety, output-TTY gating and signal exit codes, leaving only small fixes (pause journal semantics and the test-time default terminal), whereas claude's lacks amendment continuity and cursor's has stale-retry binding, timer/listener leaks and an exploitable paste-to-drop path.
